correctness.rationale: The central numerical-range symmetrization is a compact centrally symmetric convex set; support identifies each rotated selfadjoint norm. Minkowski averaging with reflection preserves both coordinate extreme radii, includes the entire four-vertex diamond, and decreases the integrated square by Jensen. Exact trigonometric integration gives the bound, and strict Jensen/strict support inclusion give iff equality. Diagonal 4x4 normal operators attain it at all parameter pairs. All limiting r=0 or s=0 cases and cubic asymptotic were independently checked. No computation substitutes for the universal proof.

value.rationale: For a recently introduced norm-like operator invariant, obtains the complete sharp two-parameter optimization under prescribed real and imaginary operator norms, across arbitrary operator dimension and nonnormality. The exact polygonal equality classification is structural and the cubic small-transverse-norm deficit quantifies rigidity. This is more than a special-matrix recomputation, as prior exact example does not prove general sharpness.
